title: Gothic lighthouse workflow example
shared_direction: A single wide frame of a stormy Gothic coast, cold slate-blue shadows and a sparse amber lantern. Keep the keeper's silhouette readable and the architecture coherent.

frames.title: Lighthouse keeper
frames.request: A lighthouse keeper in a long dark coat stands beside an iron railing at the base of a stone lighthouse, holding a small lantern. Waves break against rocks beneath distant Gothic towers. The keeper and the full lantern are clearly visible in a medium-wide composition.
